title: Hussain Gham Mein Teray Kainat Roti Hai
body:
Nikal Kay Rota Hai Din Chup Kay Raat Roti Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Pilanay Pani Chalay Jab Hussain Asghar Ko X2
Rubab Khaimay Ki Thamay Kanaat Roti Hai X2
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Is Tarha Say Luta Dosh-e-Mustafa Kay Palay X2
Teri Ghareebi Pe Allah Ki Zaat Roti Hai X2
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain Laye Thay Qalb-e-Hassan Kay Laashe Ko X2
Dulhan Ko Dekh Ke Sari Baraat Roti Hai X2
<<DIVIDER>>
Mila Na Pani Tujhay Fatima Kay Lakht-e-jigar X2
To Teri Pyaas Pay Nehr-e-Furat Roti Hai X2
<<DIVIDER>>
Utha Ke Lasha-e-Akbar Yahan Se Laykay Chalay X2
Tumhari Maut Pay Akbar Hayat Roti Hai X2
